# Template: geometric_solids
One classroom 3D solid — cube, cuboid (rectangular prism), triangular prism, square pyramid, cylinder, cone or sphere — drawn the textbook way: visible edges solid, hidden edges dashed, faces lightly shaded, and its dimensions (length, width, height, radius, side…) written beside the edges they measure, with dashed height / radius lines where a textbook draws them. Choose this scene for geometry lessons about 3D shapes, volume and surface area problems ("a cylinder with radius 3 cm and height 8 cm"), naming the parts of a solid, or comparing solids.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "solid": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "cube",
    "cuboid",
    "triangular_prism",
    "square_pyramid",
    "cylinder",
    "cone",
    "sphere"
   ],
   "description": "Which solid (default cuboid)."
  },
  "dims": {
   "type": "object",
   "description": "The measurements. Numbers set the drawn proportions AND become the labels (with unit appended); only the ones that apply to the solid are used, and only those given are labelled. cube: side. cuboid: length, width, height. triangular_prism: base, height (of the triangle), length. square_pyramid: side, height. cylinder: radius, height. cone: radius, height, slant. sphere: radius.",
   "properties": {
    "side": {
     "type": "number"
    },
    "length": {
     "type": "number"
    },
    "width": {
     "type": "number"
    },
    "height": {
     "type": "number"
    },
    "base": {
     "type": "number"
    },
    "radius": {
     "type": "number"
    },
    "slant": {
     "type": "number",
     "description": "cone only: labelled on the slanted side; does not change the shape."
    }
   }
  },
  "unit": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Appended to every number label, e.g. \"cm\"."
  },
  "labels": {
   "type": "object",
   "description": "Text overrides for dimension labels, e.g. { height: \"h\", radius: \"r\" } — shown instead of the number. A dimension with a label but no number is labelled at its default proportion.",
   "additionalProperties": {
    "type": "string"
   }
  },
  "show_hidden": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw hidden edges dashed (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- faces: the light shading on the visible faces (a group)
- edges: the visible outline — every solid edge and silhouette line (a group)
- hidden_edges: the dashed hidden edges (a group; present when show_hidden is not false and the solid has any)
- height_line / radius_line: the dashed helper lines a textbook draws for the height and radius (present when that dimension is labelled and it is not an edge)
- right_angle: the small square marking where the height meets the base (with height_line)
- dim_<name>: each dimension label: dim_side, dim_length, dim_width, dim_height, dim_base, dim_radius, dim_slant
- title: the title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a cylinder with radius 3 cm and height 8 cm." → params: {"solid":"cylinder","dims":{"radius":3,"height":8},"unit":"cm"}
Request: "Show a cuboid 6 by 3 by 4 cm with its hidden edges dashed." → params: {"solid":"cuboid","dims":{"length":6,"width":3,"height":4},"unit":"cm"}
Request: "Draw a cone and label its radius r, height h and slant height l." → params: {"solid":"cone","labels":{"radius":"r","height":"h","slant":"l"},"title":"Cone: V = ⅓πr²h"}
Request: "Draw a square-based pyramid with side 6 m and height 5 m." → params: {"solid":"square_pyramid","dims":{"side":6,"height":5},"unit":"m"}
Request: "Show a triangular prism: triangle base 4, triangle height 3, length 7." → params: {"solid":"triangular_prism","dims":{"base":4,"height":3,"length":7}}
Request: "Draw a cube with side length 5 cm." → params: {"solid":"cube","dims":{"side":5},"unit":"cm"}
Request: "Show a sphere of radius r." → params: {"solid":"sphere","labels":{"radius":"r"},"title":"Sphere: V = 4⁄3πr³"}

In YAML: `template: geometric_solids` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
